criteria.requirement: The default normalizes standard newlines to Linux LF; linesep=None preserves the original mixed CRLF/CR/LF, and explicit CRLF normalizes them all to CRLF. UTF-8 handles 茶. Use existing linesep rather than a required library patch and do not generalize Linux byte output to every platform.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
